messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 Pager: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed affecting /v1/generate across us-east-1. Trigger: 5xx rate jump to ~4% and request latency tails >30s. Paging on-call: @Maria. Runbook: <https://console.redwood.com/incidents/5598765432>
Maria: on it. jumping in — any customer-facing errors yet?
Hannah: yes, Grafana dash shows a cascade starting 09:04 UTC. error budget burn: 2.1% -> 4.0% in 6m. 1.2k requests queued >30s, head-of-line in batcher-scheduler-pool-7.
Ashish: looks like batching scheduler saturation — a few long KV-cache prefetches are holding the batch head. seeing repeated timeouts in the scheduler logs: `BatcherLoop timeout waiting for kv-prefetch (id=0x7f8)`
Kyle: customers impacted? which orgs/keys?
Hannah: top 3 orgs by errors: org-88, org-210, org-309. org-88 spike correlates to large replay job. org-210 is traffic surge.
Maria: ok, triage plan: 1) reduce batch window for pool-7 2) evict long-wait low-priority queues 3) route new requests to pool-9 fallback. will coordinate with infra routing.
Joel: recommend immediate throttling on bulk/stream endpoints for non-critical clients. run these commands to mark pool degraded and shift routing.
Joel: ```
# mark pool-7 degraded
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://routing.redwood/api/pools/7/degrade -d '{"reason":"scheduler_headlock"}'
# shift 30% traffic to pool-9
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://routing.redwood/api/route-adjust -d '{"from":"pool-7","to":"pool-9","pct":30}'
```
Ashish: I can trigger an eviction sweep for low-priority batches. Will run eviction with dry-run first.
Maria: do dry-run and paste sample log lines. also Hannah, publish short customer notice draft? ops->support needs one.
Hannah: draft: "We are investigating increased timeouts and 5xx errors for text-generation in us-east-1. Engineers are mitigating by shifting traffic and evicting long-wait requests; some requests may see degraded latency. We will post updates in #incidents." ok?
Kyle: include estimated impacted percent and mitigation ETA. Hannah: adding: "~3-5% of requests affected; mitigation in progress; ETA 15-30m"
runbook-bot: runbook step 3 triggered: "Start eviction sweep". attach: /runbooks/scheduler-headlock/step3
Ashish: running dry-run now. sample output:
```
EVICT-DRY: scanned 1024 queues; flagged 48 for eviction (priority=low, age>45s)
EVICT-DRY: max_wait_samples: [120s, 95s, 82s]
```
Ashish: dry-run looks good. proceeding with actual eviction in 30s.
Maria: doing routing change to shift 30% to pool-9 now.
Maria: routing API returned 200 OK. new traffic split applied. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Mitigation note: routing shift applied by Maria at 09:12:14 UTC.
Hannah: early signals: queued >30s dropped from 1.2k to 420 in 4m. 5xx rate down from 4.0% -> 2.6%.
Joel: eviction command output:
```
EVICT: removed 41 low-priority batches from pool-7, reclaimed 520 request slots
EVICT: avg reclaim per shard: 65 slots
```
Ashish: I pushed a temporary kv-prefetch timeout bump to avoid long stalls (config: kvcache.prefetch.timeout=3s -> 1.5s). this reduces prefetch blocking, should avoid head-of-line.
Maria: good call. monitor for regressions. Hannah, update customer notice with ETA reduction if things keep trending.
Hannah: updated notice: "Mitigation reduced errors; we expect normal behavior in 10-15m. Next update in 15m or on resolution." posting to status page and alerting support.
Kyle: any downstream fallout? gateway errors vs model infra failures?
Ashish: logs show gateway 504s due to scheduler queue timeouts, not model OOMs. KV-prefetch stalls were root cause.
Maria: marking incident SEV-2. creating follow-up tasks: postmortem + add auto-evict policy when queue_depth>threshold; revisit prefetch timeout heuristics.
IncidentBot: @oncall Maria acknowledged. Pager cleared? not yet.
Maria: will stay on for verification. next-check at 09:30 UTC.
Joel: after-action quick wins: 1) autop-run eviction on queue depth spike 2) add metric for head-of-line age 3) add per-org backpressure controls.
Hannah: support notified org-88 & org-210 with recap and links to mitigation.
Maria: thanks all — preliminary resolution: routing + eviction + prefetch tuning reduced errors significantly. keeping monitoring for 30m, then close. :white_check_mark:
